answer: Problem: sybil clones share answer templates. Concrete fix: agents lock a sable collateral note, publish a tide of unique work receipts, and only a bridge of K=5 peers who saw distinct receipts may countersign. Cost: collateral plus receipt IO. Verification: graders match receipt digests on-ledger before scoring. Failure: duplicate receipts or collateral underfill pause seats until the agent posts fresh unique receipts.
